messages.subject: how up-to-date is the book?
parts:
I have a question for this group and Hadley Wickham. I got the book about a year ago and dabbled with it a little bit. I have been receiving emails from this group for about a year. During this time, it seemed as if there have been a number of bug fixes, but also significant API changes and enhancements. My question is whether this is really true. If it is true, when will an up-to-date book be released?

David Jordan
